global: This is miso ramen, its rich, golden broth steaming warmly. Chashu pork rests beside crisp menma, crowned with shredded green onions. A light blue spoon rests in the white bowl, set against a wooden table under soft, ambient light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with blue Japanese characters on rim, smooth glossy surface, slightly curved edge.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, golden-brown, frothy surface, and visible ingredients like green onions and seaweed.
regions.spoon: A pale green spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly worn handle edge.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows layered fat and lean meat, glossy surface, irregular oval shape with visible marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a curved, segmented shape and visible fibrous texture.
